verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no employee-facing feature that explains equity in plain language, such as tax treatment, exercise windows or what dilution means for the holder. The closest items are adjacent: admin-side round modeling showing cap-table dilution, a shareholder equity-value visibility setting, and company compliance filings (Form 3921, Rule 701). These are tools for administrators, not plain-language explanations for employees, so the story is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an employee, the platform explains my equity in plain language — tax treatment, exercise windows, dilution — not just numbers
